summary: Frontend-only regression for Daneswara POS. Verified (1) variant picker accumulate-then-apply flow with note typed AFTER selecting variants, (2) editable cart note with Simpan/Batal, (3) variant qty +/- inside dialog, and (4) Dashboard Pengingat Stok Minus card. Found and fixed 2 blocker bugs in /app/frontend/src/pages/POS.jsx before tests could pass. All 4 requested flows now PASS end-to-end against the public preview URL.
action_items: Both blockers were fixed by testing agent (missing Pencil import + Selesai button not committing tempItems). Main agent should review the 2-line changes below and keep them.
Optional: keep the current onOpenChange(false) → commitVariants() branch as a safety net when user closes the variant dialog via ESC/outside click — it correctly commits any pending selections.
critical_code_review_comments: POS.jsx line 19 was missing `Pencil` import from lucide-react although it is used on line 517 inside the cart note button — this would throw ReferenceError as soon as any cart item is rendered, effectively breaking the whole POS screen. FIXED by adding Pencil to the import list.

POS.jsx line 621 previously had onClick={() => setVariantCat(null)}. Because the Dialog is CONTROLLED (open={!!variantCat}), Radix does NOT invoke onOpenChange when the parent flips the state — it only fires onOpenChange on user-initiated dismissal (ESC / overlay click / X). Therefore commitVariants() never ran when the user pressed 'Selesai', and the accumulated tempItems + note were silently discarded. FIXED to onClick={() => { commitVariants(); setVariantCat(null); }}.

POS.jsx line 570: onOpenChange still calls commitVariants() on user dismiss which is good (safety net), but be aware it can double-fire if the Selesai click also causes an outside dismissal in some edge race. In practice this is safe because tempItems is cleared inside commitVariants.
Dashboard.jsx unused imports: Search, X are imported nowhere; low priority.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily forced negative stock on product 'APRON - Drill SS' (id 7e3edf7d-00af-4b78-b34a-f90caff4314e) via POST /api/stock (type Keluar, qty 98) to make the minus-stock card appear. Restored to original stock 93 via POST /api/stock (type Opname, qty 93) at end of test. Two stock_movements rows were left in the DB as expected side-effect.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login admin/Limited0. POS variant dialog: click pos-cat-tile-*, click variant-quickadd-<pid> (button becomes qty control), optionally variant-plus-<pid> to raise qty (verify via variant-qty-<pid>), then type into variant-note-input, then click variant-done-button. Cart items must then contain cart-item-<pid> and cart-note-btn-<pid> showing the typed note. Editing: click cart-note-btn → textarea cart-note-edit-<pid> appears with Simpan/Batal. For Dashboard minus-stock, use POST /api/stock (Bearer pos_token from localStorage) with type 'Keluar' and qty > current stock — endpoint is /api/stock (not /api/inventory/*).

rca of the issue.bug1: Missing lucide-react Pencil import in POS.jsx caused ReferenceError whenever a cart item rendered (Pencil used inline in the cart-note-btn). RCA: add Pencil to the destructured import.
rca of the issue.bug2: Selesai click did not commit tempItems because Radix controlled Dialog only fires onOpenChange for user-initiated dismissals. Because the previous handler merely set open→false via setVariantCat(null), commitVariants() never ran and the tempItems + note were dropped. RCA: call commitVariants() explicitly in the button's onClick.
